name: Ursangous's Paw
summary: In Ashenvale, Ursangous's Paw proves you brought down one of the forest's fiercest predators. Bring it to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post to earn honor among the Horde's trackers.

sections.title: A Trophy of the Great Hunt
sections.body: The Ashenvale Hunt sends trackers from Splintertree Post after the ancient beasts that rule the forest canopy. Ursangous is among the fiercest, known for killing travelers and warriors who cross his path. Bringing back his paw proves the mighty beast has fallen to your hunt.

sections.title: The Night Elf Connection
sections.body: A quarter-crescent mark is carved or pressed into Ursangous's paw. Senani Thunderheart recognizes it as a sign of kaldorei influence. Night elves train and bond with formidable forest beasts to defend their sacred borders, so Ursangous may have been more than a wild predator: he may have guarded or served as a weapon for the Alliance.

faq.answer: Ursangous is an exceptionally massive, deadly bear that roams Ashenvale. Hunters and wayfarers fear him, and he claimed countless lives before the Horde's hunt brought him down.

faq.q: What does the crescent emblem on the paw mean?
faq.answer: The quarter-crescent mark on the paw is a mystery when you inspect the trophy. Senani Thunderheart can examine it when you bring her the paw.

faq.q: Who do I bring Ursangous's Paw to?
faq.answer: Bring Ursangous's Paw to Senani Thunderheart, the tauren huntress at Splintertree Post in eastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: How does this fit into the Ashenvale Hunt?
faq.answer: Ursangous is one of three great beasts hunted in Ashenvale, alongside Shadumbra and Sharptalon. Defeat all three and present their trophies to complete the rite.

faq.q: Why is the Horde hunting the great beasts of Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Horde hunters, especially the tauren and orcs at Splintertree Post, hunt these deadly beasts to test their martial prowess and curb threats near their vulnerable supply lines and encampments.

faq.q: What happens after turning in the paw?
faq.answer: After you collect Ursangous's trophy and those of the other designated quarry, Senani Thunderheart will acknowledge your triumph in the concluding trial, The Hunt Completed.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter, taking Ursangous's paw honors the beast and shows your martial resolve and respect for the spirits of the hunt.
As a member of the Horde, you can earn honor at Splintertree Post by defeating the dangerous Ursangous.
As a hunter, tracking and defeating one of Ashenvale's oldest and deadliest predators tests your fieldcraft, survival, and combat skill.
